name: ibis Styles Kota Bharu
short_description: A 130-room hotel across 19 floors in central Kota Bharu, Kelantan, built in 2015 and renovated in 2020.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Kota Bharu is a 130-room hotel spread across 19 floors in central Kota Bharu, capital of Malaysia's northeast Kelantan state, built in 2015 and renovated in 2020. The hotel serves business travelers and visitors exploring Kelantan's traditional Malay culture and markets, as well as travelers using the city as a gateway toward the Perhentian Islands. Guest reviews are consistently strong, with cleanliness, helpful staff, and the central city-centre location repeatedly praised, and it's frequently cited as one of the best hotel options currently in Kota Bharu, though breakfast quality draws more mixed comment relative to its 3-star positioning.

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Kota Bharu in the city centre?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's centrally located in Kota Bharu, Kelantan's state capital, making it convenient for the city's markets, traditional Malay culture, and cuisine, as well as functioning as a stopover for travelers heading toward the Perhentian Islands further south.

faqs.question: When was ibis Styles Kota Bharu built?
faqs.answer: It was built in 2015 and renovated in 2020, spanning 130 rooms across 19 floors, and guests frequently describe it as one of the best current hotel options in Kota Bharu for cleanliness and service.
